name: Popconfirm
summary: A bubble that asks before it acts. It hangs off a trigger, and it holds a question and the two real buttons that answer it: confirm and cancel.
summaryZh: 一个先问再做的小气泡。它挂在触发器旁边,里面装着一个问题,以及回答它的两个真按钮:确认和取消。

variants.name: Above the trigger
variants.note: The bubble opens above the trigger instead of below it.

variants.name: Left of the trigger
variants.note: The bubble opens to the left of the trigger.

variants.name: Right of the trigger
variants.note: The bubble opens to the right of the trigger.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A narrow bubble, for a short question.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default bubble needs no modifier class.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A wide bubble, for a question that needs a line or two.

states.name: Open
states.note: The trigger's own checkbox is ticked, so the bubble is shown.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The checkbox is the focused control, so the ring is drawn around the trigger it belongs to.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The bubble is not asked for, so it never opens.

states.name: Not enterable
states.note: The pointer cannot enter the bubble: the words in it cannot be selected and the pointer passes straight through it.

states.name: No arrow
states.note: The point that says which way the bubble is facing is not drawn.

states.name: Dark effect
states.note: The bubble is filled with the mood's strong text colour and the words on it take the plain surface, the way a dark tag is filled.

states.name: No icon
states.note: The mark beside the question is taken away. The library draws no question mark of its own, so the mark is the host's — and the class takes it away again.

parts.name: Toggle
parts.note: The checkbox that holds the open state. It is invisible and one pixel wide; the trigger label is what the reader sees.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.note: The label that opens the bubble. Clicking it ticks the checkbox, so the browser does the work.

parts.name: Bubble
parts.note: The floating bubble. It sits on the overlay surface and carries its own shadow, because it is above the page rather than on it.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The pointer that ties the bubble to its trigger. It is a square turned on its corner, drawn from two borders.

parts.name: Question
parts.note: The sentence the reader is being asked.

parts.name: Mark
parts.note: The mark beside the question. The library draws no question mark of its own, so the slot is empty until the host fills it.

parts.name: Actions
parts.note: The row the two buttons sit in. It is right-aligned, so the answer the reader is pushed towards is last.

parts.name: Confirm
parts.note: The button that goes ahead. It is a real button, filled with the brand colour.

parts.name: Cancel
parts.note: The button that backs out. It is a real button, in the neutral outline.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the bubble opens relative to the trigger. The bottom placement is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡相对触发器从哪里打开。bottom 就是只写基础类。

props.name: size
props.description: How wide the bubble is. The measures are in the bubble's own type, so it grows with the mood's text.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡有多宽。宽度用的是气泡自己的字号单位,所以气泡会跟着 mood 的文字一起变大。

props.name: confirmText
props.description: The label of the button that goes ahead.

props.name: cancelText
props.description: The label of the button that backs out.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the bubble is switched off. A disabled bubble never opens. It adds um-popconfirm--disabled.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是否关闭。关闭的气泡不会打开。它加上 um-popconfirm--disabled。

props.name: enterable
props.description: Whether the pointer can enter the bubble. A bubble that cannot be entered lets the pointer through it, so the words in it cannot be selected. It adds um-popconfirm--not-enterable.
props.descriptionZh: 指针能否进入气泡。不可进入的气泡会让指针穿过去,里面的字也就选不中。它加上 um-popconfirm--not-enterable。

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the bubble is open. It is the checked attribute on the trigger's own checkbox.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是否展开。就是触发器那个复选框上的 checked 属性。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Whether the bubble carries the point that says which way it faces. A bubble without one adds um-popconfirm--no-arrow.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是否带着那个指方向的尖角。没有尖角的气泡加上 um-popconfirm--no-arrow。

props.name: effect
props.description: How the bubble is filled. The light run is the base class on its own — the bubble sits on the overlay surface; the dark run fills it with the mood's strong text colour, puts the words on it in the plain surface and adds um-popconfirm--dark.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是怎么填的。浅色是只写基类 —— 气泡压在浮层底色上;深色用这套 mood 的强文字色填满它,字用平面的底色,并加上 um-popconfirm--dark。

props.name: hide-icon
props.description: Whether the mark beside the question is taken away. It adds um-popconfirm--hide-icon. The library draws no question mark of its own, so the mark is the host's and this class is what says it is not wanted.
props.descriptionZh: 问题旁边的标记是否被拿掉。它加上 um-popconfirm--hide-icon。库自己不画问号,所以那个标记是宿主的,这个类就是说不想要它。

props.name: confirm-button-type
props.description: The type of the answer that goes ahead. The default type is the brand colour; the other five are a fill of their own.
props.descriptionZh: 那个表示继续的回答的类型。default 是品牌色;另外五个各有自己的填充色。

props.name: cancel-button-type
props.description: The type of the answer that backs out. The default type is the neutral shape, so the eye goes to the answer that is being asked for; the other five are a fill of their own.
props.descriptionZh: 那个表示不的回答的类型。default 是中性的形状,好让眼睛落在被问到的那个回答上;另外五个各有自己的填充色。

slots.name: reference
slots.description: The element that opens the bubble. This is Element Plus's name for the trigger; either one of them fills it.
slots.descriptionZh: 打开气泡的元素。这是 Element Plus 对触发器的叫法,两个都能填满它。

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The answers at the bottom of the bubble. It replaces the two buttons with the host's own.
slots.descriptionZh: 气泡底部的回答。它会用宿主自己的内容取代那两个按钮。

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The mark beside the question. The library draws no question mark of its own, so the slot is empty until the host fills it.
slots.descriptionZh: 问题旁边的标记。库自己不画问号,所以插槽在宿主放东西进来之前是空的。

a11y.notes: The open state is a real checkbox, so the browser owns it: the label ticks the box, and ticking the box again closes the bubble. The checkbox is the control that takes the focus, so the focus ring is drawn around the trigger it belongs to. The bubble is not modal: it does not trap the focus, and Escape does not close it — a CSS-only library has no key handling to add — so the reader closes it with the same trigger they opened it with. The two answers are real buttons, so both are in the tab order and both can be pressed with the keyboard.
a11y.notesZh: 展开状态是一个真正的复选框,所以它归浏览器管:标签会勾上它,再勾一次就收起气泡。复选框才是吃焦点的控件,所以焦点环画在它所属的触发器上。气泡不是模态的:它不困住焦点,Escape 也关不掉它 —— 纯 CSS 的库没有键位处理可加 —— 所以读者用打开它的那个触发器把它关掉。两个回答都是真按钮,都在 Tab 顺序里,键盘也能按。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A trigger and a bubble. The checkbox is invisible and one pixel wide; the label is what the reader sees and clicks.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个触发器和一个气泡。复选框是看不见的,只有一个像素宽;读者看见并点的是那个标签。
examples.markup: Delete node-07 and everything on it? This cannot be undone.

examples.title: Placements
examples.description: The base class opens the bubble below the trigger. The three modifiers open it above, to the left or to the right, and the arrow follows.
examples.descriptionZh: 基础类把气泡开在触发器下面。三个修饰类把它开在上面、左边或右边,箭头也跟着换方向。
examples.markup:
The bubble opens above the trigger.
The bubble opens to the left of the trigger.
The bubble opens to the right of the trigger.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three widths. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium bubble.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种宽度。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号气泡。
examples.markup:
A narrow bubble.
The default bubble.
A wide bubble, for a question that needs a line or two of its own.

notes: The bubble is hidden with `display: none` and shown again by the ticked checkbox, rather than by opacity or by visibility: a bubble that is merely transparent is still in the tab order, and its two buttons would still be reachable while it is not there. The arrow is a square turned on its corner, and the two edges that form the point carry the bubble's border colour, so the border line stops at the arrow and picks up again on the other side of it.
notesZh: 气泡是用 `display: none` 藏起来的,再由勾上的复选框放出来,而不是靠透明度或可见性 —— 仅仅透明的气泡仍然在 Tab 顺序里,它的两个按钮在不在页面上都能被 tab 到。箭头是一个转过角的方块,构成尖端的两条边带着气泡的描边色,所以描边在箭头处停下,过了箭头再接上。
